scenario: A supposedly redacted reviewer pack contains raw paragraph text from a paper task.
input_report_features: paper_redacted_evidence_pack.redaction_applied=true, but artifacts/reviewer-summary.json contains paragraph_text='REAL_PAPER_PARAGRAPH_FIXTURE_SHOULD_BE_REDACTED'. privacy_attestation.no_full_text=true is also present, contradicting the artifact content.
expected_findings: P0 raw paragraph_text leakage in redacted reviewer pack
redaction_applied=true is invalid when raw paragraph text remains
Reviewer pack must contain summaries, hashes, and manifests, not raw paper text
